solution_steps: Summon Mystical Beast Serket by tributing Vorse Raider.
Activate Cathedral of the Nobles' effect, chain Call of the Haunted to bring Raider back, and Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.
Enter Battle Phase, attack St. Joan with BEUD and attack directly with Vorse
